verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Finix has API documentation, an llms.txt, a sandbox environment and an MCP server for asking questions about the API. None of it documents an interactive API reference or runnable, try-it-in-browser examples. The sandbox credentials and the MCP Q&A are separate capabilities and do not count toward this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
